items.name: Sudoku
items.how: Pay your first debt.
items.tip: To earn this, simply pay the pips in the first level.

items.name: Consolation Prize
items.how: Lose a run.
items.tip: Pretty self explanatory, obtainable once you lose a game!

items.name: Megadie
items.how: Have at least 20 dice in your bag.
items.tip: To earn this, you must have at least a minimum of 20 dice in your bag. You can get more dice by purchasing more in the shops in between the levels in exchange for pips.

items.name: D10
items.how: Have a die reach 10 extra value.
items.tip: To earn this, you need to make a die reach 10 extra value. Extra value can be obtained with other dice, such as with the Psychodie that gives extra value equal to the faces of nearby dice.

items.name: Star Ring
items.how: Beat a Boss round.
items.tip: You can obtain this by defeating your first boss!

items.name: Time Bomb
items.how: Beat Face 1.
items.tip: Self explanatory, you can earn this after going through all 5 levels and beating the first boss!

items.name: Red Hand
items.how: Beat Face 1.

items.name: Rubik's Cube
items.how: Have 9 dice on the table.
items.tip: This one can be obtained by rolling dice that will roll more dice after you've rolled them! (Examples: Bottle of Caps, which can roll between 1-14 bottle caps on the table once rolled.)

items.name: Hoarder Ring
items.how: Have at least 25 dice in your bag.
items.tip: To earn this, you must have at least a minimum of 25 dice in your bag. You can get more dice by purchasing more in the shops in between the levels in exchange for pips.

items.name: Piñata
items.how: Get at least 1000 pips in a single roll.
items.tip: To do this, you can get creative with your builds! I personally like to combo dice that give multipliers (Examples: Glass Die, Cupidie, Oxidie). There's no one true solution to this one. Roll enough so that you can get 1k pips minimum in one roll!

items.name: Pocket Pencil
items.how: Have a D20 in your bag.
items.tip: Self explanatory. Get a D20 in your bag! (Can be obtained through shops, dice packs, and mystery bags.)

items.name: Last Breath
items.how: Lose to a boss.
items.tip: Simply lose to a boss. Must die (hah) specifically to a boss.

items.name: Diamond Die
items.how: Have a single die reach at least 100X Multiplier.
items.tip: To obtain this, you must have at least one die reach 100X Multiplier. The best way to do this is to just spam dice that do give multiplier bonuses, (Cupidie, Oxidie, Glass Die, etc.) Stamp multiplier bonuses also contribute to this.

items.name: Ivory Die
items.how: Get one stamp multiplier to at least 1.7X.
items.tip: To obtain this, you need to get at least one stamp multiplier to 1.7X. To do that, you can purchase stamp packs that increase the multipliers by 0.3 or 0.5 depending on the stamp pack you obtained.

items.name: Magic Ring
items.how: Have at least 5 enchanted dice in your bag.

items.name: Purple Hand
items.how: Have at least 5 enchanted dice in your bag.
items.tip: Enchanted dice can be obtained through shops, or you could enchant your dice through cards or enchantment rooms.

items.name: Equivalent Link
items.how: Have at least 10k pips.

items.name: Incubus Die
items.how: Remove 10 dice in a single run.
items.tip: For this one, you can remove dice in the shop in between stages. It's easier to get this if you're playing as Red Hand, as the stores are discounted. Getting a dice to break while rolling also contributes to this.

items.name: Die of Fortune
items.how: Have at least 5 rare or legendary dice in your bag.
items.tip: This one shouldn't be too difficult, as you get this as you play the game. Just collect 5 rare or legendary dice!

items.name: Bling Bling

items.name: Philatelist's Ring

items.name: Exodie
items.how: Make a Psychodie affect 5 dice in a single roll.
items.tip: This one can be easily obtained by using a Magnet Die with the Psychodie. You could also use dice that roll more dice on the table so that more dice will be affected by the Psychodie's area of effect.

items.name: Cosmic Die
items.how: Have exactly 42 pips.
items.tip: I'm gonna be honest I got lucky getting this particular achievement. You just need to have exactly 42 pips.

items.name: Translucid D4
items.how: Roll 4 fours in a single roll.
items.tip: This one takes a bit of luck, or you could also just combo your dice and rings. With a D4 and an equity ring, you could use a choose card to set it to roll to 4, and every other D4 you roll along with it should also land a 4.

items.name: Static Hand
items.how: To get this hand, you need to donate enough stars in the star shop (the shop after you defeat a boss.) Once you get the message "You feel something change in Face X", the next ring reward segment allows you to pay pips for a secret shop. In that shop, you need to sacrifice one die of each tier of rarity (common, uncommon, rare, and legendary, the dice in your bag are also selected at random). Once you've successfully filled those requirements, a chest pops up containing the Static Hand!

items.name: Echo Cube
items.how: Click the Echo Cube when one shows up among your dice.
items.tip: This can be obtained by flicking the Echo Cube at the starting screen. In the background once you've opened the game, random dice will start falling, to which you can click on them to "flick" them. Obtaining the Echo Cube then becomes a matter of luck and patience, as you have to wait for the die to fall from the screen, and there are no ways to speed up the process. A general tip would be to just keep clicking in one spot until you finally catch it!
